I've answered Pree in the thread under her message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

On 9 June she posted in #central-team that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had arrived at 7:10 and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note.

I couldn't find a site code or address for Pine Crossing in that channel or the shared files. All I have is the store name, and I said so in the reply.
